entities.name: Onatah
entities.description: An Anaba shaman of the Minotaur tribe in the Koskun Mountains of Ulgrotha, with formidable control over storms and lightning.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Mountains of Ulgrotha where the Anaba hide.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A planeswalker who lived among the Anaba and delivered them from peril.

entities.name: Baki the Wizard Attendant
entities.description: Recognized the Anaba Shamans' mastery over earth's powers.

entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: Dismissed the Anaba Shamans as incapable of true magic.

events.summary: Onatah honors Feroz's legacy through the Didgeridoo and ceremony.
events.quote: She revered the Didgeridoo, an instrument symbolic of her people

relations.quote: Onatah was an Anaba shaman from Ulgrotha
a Planeswalker who had once lived among the Anaba and delivered them from peril
